messages.content: First write a 250-word introduction to 19th-century English novels. Then, in the same turn, call the web fetch tool three times: https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/1342/pg1342.txt , https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/84/pg84.txt and https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/2701/pg2701.txt . Then quote the first sentence of each book.
